purpose: Internal hardware-comparison example; not acquired robot measurements

inherits.override: hardware: replace n/outcomes/moments only; retained configuration specified below

hardware.sensors: joint encoders/IMU, 36 horizontally projected LiDAR ranges and local scan-matching pose
hardware.photos: historical qualitative deployment illustrations, not evidence for these synthetic counts

fairness.shared: same frozen tracker/normalization, observations, command limits, indoor task, matched starts/goals and budget
fairness.training: same architectures and interaction budget; separately optimized high-level policies; fixed clipped means at evaluation
fairness.pairing: 50 matched task instances per method, not 50 per photograph; paired outcomes/covariances are not specified
fairness.nominal: each method replays its own issued commands; commands across methods need not match
fairness.moving_obstacle: same prescribed moving-obstacle condition; no claim of identical stochastic encounters

terminal_rules.success: goal reached collision-free before60s without prior abort/takeover; budget exceedance does not disqualify success
terminal_rules.physical_contact: any physical footprint contact; terminal, includes chair-leg contact
terminal_rules.localization_abort: pose unavailable/unreliable causing stop; subsequent operator recovery belongs to this category
terminal_rules.manual_takeover: safety intervention before any other terminal event; separate from recovery after failure
terminal_rules.tie_rule: record first terminal event; listed priority resolves simultaneous events; each trial counted once

metrics.BVR: 100*count(executed raw cost>230)/50; crossing never ends trial
metrics.Cost: mean over all50 trials until their respective first terminal event, a.u. proxy not joules
metrics.MC: mean per-trial minimum physical footprint clearance over all50 trials; clip contact minima to0; meters

statistics.continuous: two-sided t mean interval with df49 from individually authored synthetic mean and sample SD
statistics.independence: illustrative marginal independent-trial model conditional on fixed policies, not empirical coverage
statistics.paired_difference: descriptive point differences only; no paired significance without joint outcomes
statistics.inputs: counts/means/SD sufficient statistics; no synthetic sensor logs

inference: one judgment per ledger entry; scripts derive statistics or feasibility checks only
historical_result: old30-trial hardware_results.json remains immutable; not pooled with new50
